name: How long does it take to fix a clogged drain?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a clogged drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to fix a clogged drain depends on its complexity. Minor clogs in a sink or shower can often be resolved within an hour using standard tools. More severe blockages, such as those in a main sewer line or those caused by tree roots, might require a few hours or even a half-day, especially if camera inspections or hydro-jetting are needed. We strive for efficient service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor clogs can be fixed in under an hour. More severe or main line clogs may take a few hours, depending on the tools and inspection needed.
